title: fix(mcp): fetch_and_analyze timeout — per-source budget + allSettled + ragIndex guard

changes: Add per-source timeout wrappers: cafef=10s, vnexpress=10s, vneconomy=12s, reuters=15s (from 30s) (REC-1).
Add optional use_ingested: z.boolean().default(false) + since_minutes: z.coerce.number().default(120) params (REC-4).
When use_ingested=true: read rag_analyses WHERE created_at >= datetime('now', '-N minutes') and skip Steps 1+4.
Add signal: AbortSignal.timeout(8_000) to ragIndex() fetch() call (REC-3).
Add signal: AbortSignal.timeout(8_000) to ragSearch() fetch() call (REC-3).

scenarios: Inject slow source mock (sleeps 20s via delayed Promise) — verify tool returns within 20s with partial results from other sources.
Inject slow ragIndex mock (sleeps 15s) — verify Step 4 completes within 10s (AbortSignal fires).
use_ingested=true — verify ragIndex NOT called, SQLite read path used, rows within since_minutes window returned.
use_ingested=false default — verify existing network path unchanged (non-regression).

qa_gate.description: Integration test with injected slow mocks must pass before merge. No Playwright required. No ops rebuild until tests green.
pass_criteria: fetch_and_analyze(all sources, limit=20) wall clock <= 25s under normal conditions (down from 55-60s worst case).

ops_rebuild_note: After merge and tests green, ops must rebuild + restart mcp-server container to deploy. The fix is in interface + infrastructure layers — no schema change, no migration.
dispatch_constraint: Do NOT run this alongside other apps/mcp-server/ tasks. Zone-exclusive. Sequential dispatch.
